brief.name: Sela Mor
brief.offer: Sound artist and composer from Baku: field recordings of wind, water and machines, turned into music for rooms, films and long nights.

pages.label: Home
pages.purpose: Establish mood and promise in seconds; orient the visitor to what this site is and give them a clear next step.

pages.label: Works
pages.purpose: Prove quality and range through the strongest projects; make it easy to go deeper on any one.

pages.label: Listen
pages.purpose: Let people hear the work: six tracks from her records and installations, each with a player, its length, where it was recorded and what it was made for; one plays at a time.

pages.label: Live
pages.purpose: Where to hear her next: upcoming performances and installations with dates, places and tickets, then the last season’s shows.

pages.label: About
pages.purpose: Put a human face and point of view on the work; build trust.

pages.label: Contact
pages.purpose: Give one clear, low-friction way to get in touch.
